description: Website trackers & third-party inventory — Privacy scan of a public web page: every third-party host it loads (scripts, iframes, pixels, stylesheets, preconnects, form posts) classified against a built-in vendor list (advertising, analytics, session replay, tag managers, marketing, A/B testing, consent managers, CDNs, fonts, video, payments), plus trackers referenced in inline scripts (gtag, fbq, hotjar...). Returns privacy score/grade, vendors by category, consent manager, and flags such as trackers without a consent manager or session replay. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_trackers
